EMPLOYMENT ARBITRATION AGREEMENT
Prepared for Jordan Lee · Acme, Inc.

AGREEMENT TO ARBITRATE
Except as provided below, Acme, Inc. and Jordan Lee agree to resolve any employment-related dispute between them through individual, binding arbitration rather than in court — including a dispute about the enforceability of this agreement itself. Both Acme, Inc. and Jordan Lee give up the right to bring or participate in a class, collective, or representative action against the other; each dispute is resolved on an individual basis.

[Verified — checked 2026-08-29]
  "A written provision in any maritime transaction or a contract evidencing a transaction involving commerce to settle by arbitration a controversy thereafter arising out of such contract or transaction, or the refusal to perform the whole or any part thereof, or an agreement in writing to submit to arbitration an existing controversy arising out of such a contract, transaction, or refusal, shall be valid, irrevocable, and enforceable, save upon such grounds as exist at law or in equity for the revocation of any contract or as otherwise provided in chapter 4."
  — 9 U.S.C. § 2 (Cornell LII text), U.S. Code, Federal Arbitration Act, validity of arbitration agreements (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/9/2)
  "Congress has instructed in the Arbitration Act that arbitration agreements providing for individualized proceedings must be enforced, and neither the Arbitration Act’s saving clause nor the NLRA suggests otherwise."
  — Epic Systems Corp. v. Lewis, 584 U.S. 497 (2018) (https://www.courtlistener.com/opinion/4499694/epic-systems-corp-v-lewis/)
  Known gap: Federal law generally requires an agreement like this one to be enforced according to its terms, including the individual-proceedings requirement above — a party can't get out of that by pointing to a conflicting state law or a different federal statute unless Congress said so specifically, and the U.S. Supreme Court has already rejected an argument that a different federal labor law overrides this one. The exception below is one of the few places Congress actually has said so.

EXCEPTION FOR SEXUAL ASSAULT AND SEXUAL HARASSMENT CLAIMS
Despite the agreement above, Jordan Lee isn't required to arbitrate a dispute about sexual assault or sexual harassment. Federal law gives the person raising that kind of claim — not Acme, Inc. — the choice of whether arbitration applies to it, and that choice controls even though this document was signed before the dispute existed.

[Verified — checked 2026-08-29]
  "The term “sexual assault dispute” means a dispute involving a nonconsensual sexual act or sexual contact, as such terms are defined in section 2246 of title 18 or similar applicable Tribal or State law, including when the victim lacks capacity to consent. ... The term “sexual harassment dispute” means a dispute relating to conduct that is alleged to constitute sexual harassment under applicable Federal, Tribal, or State law."
  — 9 U.S.C. § 401 (Cornell LII text), U.S. Code, Ending Forced Arbitration of Sexual Assault and Sexual Harassment Act of 2021, definitions (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/9/401)
  "Notwithstanding any other provision of this title, at the election of the person alleging conduct constituting a sexual harassment dispute or sexual assault dispute, or the named representative of a class or in a collective action alleging such conduct, no predispute arbitration agreement or predispute joint-action waiver shall be valid or enforceable with respect to a case which is filed under Federal, Tribal, or State law and relates to the sexual assault dispute or the sexual harassment dispute."
  — 9 U.S.C. § 402 (Cornell LII text), U.S. Code, Ending Forced Arbitration of Sexual Assault and Sexual Harassment Act of 2021, election to void (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/9/402)
  Known gap: This exception is deliberately narrow: it applies to a sexual assault or sexual harassment dispute specifically, not to every claim someone might raise alongside one. Whether a mixed case — some claims related to harassment, others not — can be split between arbitration and court is a real, litigated question this document doesn't resolve; the statute gives the election only over the sexual-harassment or sexual-assault dispute itself.

WHAT THIS DOESN'T LIMIT
This agreement doesn't limit Jordan Lee's right to file a charge or complaint with a government agency, such as the EEOC or the National Labor Relations Board. Agreeing to arbitrate private claims doesn't bind an agency that wasn't a party to this agreement — the agency can still pursue its own enforcement action, including relief specific to Jordan Lee, even after Jordan Lee signed this agreement.

[Verified — checked 2026-08-29]
  "Absent textual support for a contrary view, it is the public agency’s province — not that of the court — to determine whether public resources should be committed to the recovery of victim-specific relief. And if the agency makes that determination, the statutory text unambiguously authorizes it to proceed in a judicial forum."
  — Equal Employment Opportunity Commission v. Waffle House, Inc., 534 U.S. 279 (2002) (https://www.courtlistener.com/opinion/118475/equal-employment-opportunity-commission-v-waffle-house-inc/)
  "If within thirty days after a charge is filed with the Commission or within thirty days after expiration of any period of reference under subsection (c) or (d), the Commission has been unable to secure from the respondent a conciliation agreement acceptable to the Commission, the Commission may bring a civil action against any respondent not a government, governmental agency, or political subdivision named in the charge."
  — 42 U.S.C. § 2000e-5(f)(1) (Cornell LII text), U.S. Code, Title VII, EEOC's independent authority to bring a civil action (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/42/2000e-5)
  Known gap: This is well-established for the EEOC specifically, including its authority to seek backpay or other individual relief in its own enforcement action. Once the employee personally chooses to pursue a claim rather than let an agency pursue it on the public's behalf, this arbitration agreement still applies to that personal choice — an agency's independence from this agreement doesn't create a personal escape hatch from it.

ACKNOWLEDGMENT
Please sign below to indicate your understanding of and agreement to the terms above.

Employee: Jordan Lee
Date: _______________

—
